decisions.reason: As a 2023 laser workstation line that still remained on the site in 2024, it extends the core marking portfolio and is cheap enough to keep as a still-learning option despite not being a strategic centerpiece.

The thermal inkjet printer stayed on its own page across 2023 and 2024 and is close to the established offer, so the firm is likely to preserve this low-risk adjacent option while demand information continues to accumulate.

The piezo inkjet printer also kept a dedicated page through 2024, and for a large R&D-active German machinery firm it is sensible to hold this adjacent technology option unless clearer evidence of weak uptake appears.

As a 2024 flagship laser line shown on the home page and closely aligned with the firm's Industry 4.0 traceability direction, this option is strategically important and very unlikely to be withdrawn so early.
The newly launched compact laser marking cabin has a dedicated page and fits the expanding laser family, so management would usually keep it on the market while early uncertainty resolves.

Although this sheet-metal lubricant printing system is more specialized, its trade-fair award provides positive signal value, making it worthwhile to continue as a niche option for at least another year.
